state_convention.serialization: row-major: row 0 bytes, then row 1, row 2, row 3

fixed_first_round.accepted_output_family: all bytes are 00 except x[3][2] = d, where d ranges over 00..ff
fixed_first_round.base_values: the four active S-box inputs are independent uniform bytes; inactive bytes contribute deterministically
fixed_first_round.branch_count_definition: for each d, n1[d] is the number of the 256^4 active-byte base-input tuples producing the accepted output

three_stage_middle.experiment: conditioned on a first-round branch d, draw z1,z2,z3 independently and uniformly from 00..ff; set delta1=S(z1) xor S(z1 xor d), delta2=S(z2) xor S(z2 xor delta1), delta3=S(z3) xor S(z3 xor delta2), and b=parity(09 AND delta3)
three_stage_middle.signed_count_definition: n3[d] = sum over all 256^3 tuples (z1,z2,z3) of (-1)^b

target.normalization_reason: four independent active-byte inputs in the first round and three independent byte inputs in the middle
target.scope: the fixed Markov/generalized-DLCT object above; not an unrestricted search and not a claim about every four-round AES distinguisher
